profile.name: Taylor Morgan
profile.summary: Marketing coordinator with three years of experience running email and social campaigns for a regional health network and a retail brand. Comfortable with HubSpot, Google Analytics and Excel, and used to turning campaign results into short reports for managers.

descriptions: Plan and send 10 to 12 patient email campaigns a month in HubSpot; average open rate rose from 24% to 31%
Built a monthly Looker Studio report on appointment requests that the director uses in budget meetings
Coordinate print and social assets for 14 clinic locations with two designers and an outside print vendor
Wrote the team's first email style guide, which cut review rounds per campaign from three to one
Scheduled Instagram and Facebook posts for three store openings; followers grew from 4,800 to 9,100
Tracked weekly promo results in Excel and flagged two coupon codes that were losing money
Wrote product descriptions for about 150 items when the online store launched in 2022
Helped about 80 customers a shift and trained five new hires on the register and returns process
Built the weekly endcap displays for seasonal items, which the store manager used as the model for other aisles
Coursework: Public Relations Writing, Digital Media Strategy, Marketing Research, Statistics
Marketing: HubSpot, Mailchimp, Google Analytics, Canva, Hootsuite
Data: Excel (pivot tables), Looker Studio, SQL
Certifications: HubSpot Content Marketing, Google Analytics Certification

SUMMARY

Marketing coordinator with three years of experience running email and social campaigns for a regional health network and a retail brand. Comfortable with HubSpot, Google Analytics and Excel, and used to turning campaign results into short reports for managers.

EDUCATION
Coursework: Public Relations Writing, Digital Media Strategy, Marketing Research, Statistics

Marketing: HubSpot, Mailchimp, Google Analytics, Canva, Hootsuite
Data: Excel (pivot tables), Looker Studio, SQL
Certifications: HubSpot Content Marketing, Google Analytics Certification
Languages: English (native), Spanish (conversational)
